issues.problem: English adds "— testing his host —" after Hou Ying climbs into the seat of honor, attributing a deliberate testing motive to him; the Chinese only describes the behavior (径直上车坐了上座，不让) and states no such intent.
issues.suggestion: Delete "— testing his host —" (or say only "without yielding the seat").

issues.problem: English adds details absent from Chinese: "the eastern gate of Daliang" (ZH only says 夷门 / 大梁夷门), "called on him" before the gift, "when everyone was seated", and "with his carriage and escort".
issues.suggestion: Trim to the Chinese scope, e.g. "kept the Yimen, a gate of Daliang" and "wanted to make him a handsome gift".

issues.problem: The causal 以致 ("so that / resulting in") before 食客三千人 is rendered as "until he had three thousand retainers", turning a result into a time sequence.
issues.suggestion: Read as "so that he had three thousand retainers".

overall: The English edition matches the Chinese in facts, dates, numbers, names and quotations throughout; the only discrepancies are minor added glosses in the Hou Ying carriage episode and one causal-to-temporal slip.
